mapper.select: SELECT id, pilot_id, title, content, order_num, created_at, updated_at FROM pilot_mindmaps WHERE pilot_id = #{pilotId} ORDER BY order_num ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pilot_mindmaps (pilot_id, title, content, order_num, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{pilotId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{orderNum}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE pilot_mindmaps SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, order_num = #{orderNum}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
